senses.gloss: f. (יְתַר) remaining over, too much, too many; extraordinary, especial.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 26:12">Ib.</cite> <he>דיַתִּירָא</he> (ed. Berl. <he>דיָתְרָא</he>, Y. <cite ref="J00739"><he>יְתֵירָא</he></cite>). Ib. 13.—
<cite ref="Chullin 47a:2">Ḥull. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>חסיר או י׳</he> one lobe wanting or one too many.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 93b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>נטירותא י׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>מעלייתא</he>) a special watchfulness.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 4a:10">M. Kat. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>טירחא יתירה איכא</he> (read <he>יתירא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) it requires great labor.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 21a:3">Ib. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מילתא י׳</he> something more than duty requires.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104b:10">B. Mets. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>מילתא י׳</he> a disproportionate amount.
<cite ref="Gittin 64b:5">Gitt. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>ידא י׳</he> an additional hand (her own and her father’s power of accepting the letter of divorce).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 104b:1">B. Bath. 104ᵇ</cite> top [read:] <he>ואי איכא יתירא</he> and if there is a surplus, v. <cite ref="M01567"><he>מַלֵּיתָא</he></cite>.—
B. Kam. 94ᵃ תעזוב י׳ the superfluous verse containing תעזב (Lev. XIX, 10, repeated ib. XXIII, 22); a. fr.—Esp. יתירתא an additional lobe of the lungs.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 51a:8">B. Mets. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>בדמי י׳</he> at an extremely high price.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:9:5">Cant. R. to II, 9</cite> <he>אילין י׳</he> those forty five days more (<cite ref="Daniel 12:11">Dan. XII, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Daniel 12:12">12</cite>).
Ab. Zar. 9ᵇ sq. ההוא שטרא … שית שנין י׳ a document which contained six years too many (was postdated by six years); a. fr.—Adv. יַתִּיר more.
Targ. Ps. XIX, 11; a. e.—בְּיַתִּירְתָּא (= h. יותר מדאי) beyond measure.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:14">M. Kat. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>הות קא בכיא בי׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בתדירתא</he>) she mourned unreasonably.
